question: The 'Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan' (PM-AASHA) has________ components to rationalise the government agricultural produce price and policy for efficiency, savings by way of reduction of wastages and leakages in storage and make fiscal gains.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan' (PM-AASHA)** has **three **components to rationalise the government agricultural produce price and policy for efficiency, savings by way of reduction of wastages and leakages in storage and making fiscal gains.
 
• It is a scheme that guarantees a **Minimum support price (MSP)** to the farmers.
 
• The scheme is an effort of the government’s commitment to ensure remunerative prices to farmers for their produce as announced in the **Union Budget for 2018. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The scheme comprises three sub-schemes:**

 
 
• Price Support Scheme (PSS)

 
 
• ​Under this, physical procurement of pulses, oilseeds, and Copra is to be done by Central Nodal Agencies in collaboration with state governments.
 
 
 
• Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS)
 
 
• ​This is based on the recommendations of NITI Aayog which suggested “Price Deficiency Payment” for implementation of MSP in crops where procurement is poor.
 
• Direct payment of the difference between the MSP and the selling price will be made to pre-registered farmers selling their produce in the notified market yard and thus it does not involve any physical procurement.
 
 
 
• The pilot of the Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPPS)
 
 
• Under this scheme, participation of the private sector in procurement operations will be piloted.
 
• States have the option to roll out the scheme on a pilot basis in selected districts/APMCs involving private stockists.
